notes: 契约单向采纳+落地链路加固：①capture 契约按 semver 单向采纳（本机>契约→升级，<→保持，修掉 nightly 升级后契约永久冻在旧版）；②初始化推送契约复用 Get-HostAppVersion（打包版不再把 Electron 框架版本误写成 appVersion）；③apply 四处硬编码版本/目录名映射改运行时推导（frozen-lockfile 不再因版本错位必挂）；④推送前先 fetch 核对云端领先即停（防镜像删除清掉他机独有会话/附件）；⑤-WorkspaceOnly 也先做 DSH 运行检查（防与运行中客户端互踩）。附带：git add 走 cmd 转发、push 分类补 non-fast-forward、capture cwd 归一统一执行器+$PID 临时名、notices byKind 补 landing、面板 AutoCard 请求统一走 callAuto、必需组单项勾选禁用。
notesEn: One-way contract adoption + landing hardening: (1) capture adopts the host contract one-way by semver (newer local upgrades it, older keeps it — fixes contracts frozen on old versions after nightly auto-updates); (2) initialize-push contract reuses Get-HostAppVersion (packaged builds no longer write the Electron framework version as appVersion); (3) apply derives all previously hard-coded versions/directory maps at runtime (frozen-lockfile no longer fails on drift); (4) push fetches first and stops when the cloud is ahead (prevents mirror-delete wiping other machines' unrecoverable sessions/attachments); (5) -WorkspaceOnly now runs the DSH process check too (no more racing a live client). Also: git add via cmd forwarding, push failure classification adds non-fast-forward, capture cwd normalization unified executor + $PID temp names, notices byKind counts landing, panel AutoCard uses callAuto, required-group item checkboxes disabled.
